_comment: Per-set × per-case budgets over pano_metrics.py outputs (test_pano_pipeline.sh). One-way ratchet under engineering control: ceilings only go DOWN and the coverage FLOOR only goes UP, in the same commit that delivers the improvement. Semantics or direction changes are OWNER decisions and carry a dated note. 2026-06-12 (owner): pano_01 re-encoded after #1225 (place-every-frame retention + stage-F mesh + fixed-point pruning) — greens ratcheted to the measured all-21 result (mean 1.13, rmse 0.2026, seam 8.88e-4, coverage 0.928) with ~6% slack; max_reproj raised 6.0→6.05 (the measured 6.006 is one evidence-floor pair of an open-water frame — pruning it would un-pose the frame; ratchet back when alignment earns it); horizon_tilt raised 0.3→0.4 (the metric gates the WORST single camera's x-axis, and one motion-degraded pose owns it even when the rendered horizon is level — revisit if the metric is re-encoded as a rendered-horizon measure). More fixture sets are planned; new sets follow the run-once → observed+5-10% flow.
